title: Core owns lifetime; TypeScript keeps query algorithms.
fact: A service creates its own scope. This is reusable code in core, not a shared cache across services.
reason: The architecture spec assigns language-independent cache lifetime to core; semantic query bodies stay in TypeScript.

title: Keep one scope with six isolated handles.
fact: Five stores use symbol-identity keys; one uses file-and-position keys. References and callers still share a location search.
reason: The PR chooses separate handles over a shared map because their key and value spaces are independent.

title: Preserve exact cached values, including empty results and undefined.
fact: Use Map.has. Cached promises keep identity; reference and node projections are rebuilt from cached locations on access.
reason: The PR names undefined as a valid value and explicitly preserves existing promise/value identities and algorithms.

title: Retry synchronous throws; retain rejected promises for the turn.
fact: The factory runs before insertion. There are no promise-settlement writes, so old work can settle without replacing a new entry.
reason: The PR explicitly preserves failure behavior; the new core tests characterize both failure forms and late settlement.

title: Begin a turn only after a successful refresh.
fact: Keep the existing order: failed refresh retains current cache entries; any successful refresh clears them, even with unchanged files.
reason: The PR says failed refresh must preserve the current successful turn, instead of clearing at refresh entry.

title: Clear synchronously before awaiting project release.
fact: Both versions clear first. The new core scope empties every handle before the service waits for project cleanup.
reason: The PR says released semantics must be unavailable while project release is pending or rejecting.

title: Extend the backend’s completion and failure boundary.
fact: Service release now returns Promise<void>; the backend awaits it. Project completion or rejection now reaches that caller.
reason: The PR describes this change, but gives no separate reason for adding the caller-visible contract change to a lifetime-only layer under an unchanged-behavior spec.

title: Expose the scope API; narrow beginTurn to a file list.
fact: Core exports a scope and getOrCreate-only handle. The service takes readonly WorkspaceFile[] instead of WorkspaceSnapshot and retains that array.
reason: The public signatures are listed in the PR. No distinct rationale was found for these exact API shapes or for narrowing the service input.

title: Clear entries without revoking handles or cancelling work.
fact: Handles work before beginTurn and after release, can refill during release, and survive repeated clearing. There is no disposal or unregister API.
reason: The implementation and tests establish this behavior; the inspected material gives no separate reason for this unguarded lifecycle surface.

title: Add ten characterization tests; retain the five existing cases.
fact: Four new core cases and six service/backend cases. No existing assertion is weakened or removed. Delayed rejection is tested with a fake graph; no new delayed-success release case is added.
reason: The characterization commit and the PR’s preservation intent explain locking identity, failure, and lifecycle behavior.
